features: dual-lens design: vertical layout for detail, horizontal layout for near-180 panoramic view
smart full-colour night vision (motion triggers full-colour recording in complete darkness)
dual infrared lights (x2) plus human night vision, 10m range
dual-view AI detection: person detection, vehicle detection, someone approaches vehicle
personal area protection (source-side masking of marked regions)
intrusion alarm with warning light and notifications
two-way voice calls via Xiaomi Home app
release_notes: No official RTSP or ONVIF support (streaming is normally via the Xiaomi Home app only). Supported by go2rtc v1.9.13+ via the xiaomi:// source using Xiaomi's 'miss' (Mi Secure Streaming) protocol: streaming is local (same subnet), but internet access is required at each connection to obtain encryption keys. Frigate can consume the go2rtc restream. go2rtc's maintainer indicates cameras released after 2020 (unified 'miss' protocol, cs2) generally work; this specific model is not yet in the community-verified list (AlexxIT/go2rtc#1982) - test and report. go2rtc supports the second lens of dual cameras via channel=2. Official spec table lists resolution as '2304 x 1296, Dual-image' and describes the picture as '2K HD'.
